cohort: The study included 263 neonates from a hospital in Mashhad, Iran, comprising 149 neonates with idiopathic jaundice and 114 healthy controls, all with a gestational age of >35 weeks.
finding: Neonates with idiopathic jaundice had significantly lower mean serum zinc levels compared to healthy neonates (841.42 +/- 211.99 µmol/L vs 1024.74 +/- 245.17 µmol/L, P < 0.001).
mod_finding: No significant correlation was observed between serum zinc levels and mode of delivery.
cross-section timing: At the time of hospitalization/diagnosis for idiopathic jaundice, between 2008 and 2010.
